text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hm-hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Ai-chan♡
Good evening. You seem to be in high spirits today~☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pandora-san.
I just got out of the bath
and was getting some fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, it feels so good, doesn't it~? I love it too☆
Especially for an Ai-chan who loves baths so much, right~♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there are plenty of other ways to enjoy a bath,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, come by the Miho Dorms tomorrow.
I'll let you experience a bath that
feels absolutely heavenly!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And so. We've decided to hold an impromptu "Miho Dorm Bath Day" today, so let's begin the meeting.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
…………
P-Please...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then, as usual,
let's start by choosing our bath salts.
Does anyone have an opinion on what scent we should go with?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Boo wants to float cypress balls
in the bathtub! It sounds so fun!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. In that case, pairing it with a complementary
citrus-based aroma might also—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Um... Hishi Ama-senpai.
What's this meeting even about~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're from the Ritto Dorm, so you wouldn't know.
Over here, Ai hosts a regular bath appreciation get-together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
After all, her love for baths is second to none.
Carefully selected bath salts, soothing background music to match, and even lighting candles to set the mood.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know. To put it simply,
she's basically Miho's bath enforcer, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That's Ai-chan for you.
She's so thorough...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Now then—everything's all set.
All that's left is to fill it with hot water and add the bath salts!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, great work~☆
Now then, at last—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, finally—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: All right! Just 30 more slope sprints to go! Let's pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Why are we going running here of all places~!?
When's the bath!? Where is it!? Whaaat's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm getting in, okay?
But before that, I need to do some "bath exercises"!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This'll work up a great sweat
and make your bath feel that much better afterwards!
Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whew, phew...!
Come on, you're taking this way too seriously, Ai-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...*yaaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It feels wonderful to relax and look at the stars after taking a bath, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh, it really feels so soft and fluffy...
I'm, like, totally speechless...♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Still, look at that~. Ai-chan, you really, reeeally love baths, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Of course it's meant for conditioning my body, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I work hard for my own sake.
To win. I never think of it as painful, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But... soaking in the bath
makes me feel like I'm being rewarded
for all that hard work.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Telling me, "Ai, you worked hard today."
And, "You can do your best tomorrow too."
That time... felt so comforting.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I like baths.
No, I love them!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Only if you're up for it, Pandora-san...
Would you like to go for a second round in the baths together?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go, let's go~♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—And so,
I ended up doing 5 whole sets.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's been so long since I had such a nice, long soak! Thanks to that, I feel completely refreshed♪
choice_data_list: Going “slow” becomes the source of “speed”, huh.
Going “slow” becomes the source of “speed”, huh.
It's amazing you have the stamina to keep that up...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's been so long since I had such a nice, long soak! Thanks to that, I feel completely refreshed♪
choice_data_list: Going “slow” becomes the source of “speed”, huh.
Going “slow” becomes the source of “speed”, huh.
It's amazing you have the stamina to keep that up...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Exactly! I'm itching so bad to run right now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get to building that "speed" again today,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you should try it next time too, Trainer.
It's very refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If we ever get the chance to go to a hot spring together,
I'll give you a whole lecture on the proper way to bathe!
